evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Quinton performs a settled operational rule with ratification language ('from now on') and a declarative that treats the rehearsal as constitutive of having the rollback — decision-grade performed settling.
The document itself labels what follows as decisions, performing the settling by ratification header — decision-grade by the document's own act of recording.
Flat unhedged assertion recording the settled cadence as an operational fact under the 'Key decisions' header — decision-grade by ratification context.
Assigning an owner is a performed act of settling — the document records who is accountable, ratifying the decision's execution.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed by declaring that an unexercised capability does not exist, rather than merely asserting it should be exercised?
